questions.question: 🐆 Mina, now a national reference in helping relationships, is invited to an international congress. What message should she convey?
options: Patient relations are a model of humanization of care
Patient relations are reserved for specialists
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Patient relations are a model of humanization of care.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must create a foundation to promote helping relationships. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Promoting the humanization of care is essential for the future of the profession.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must write a reference work on helping relationships. What is the central message?
options: Helping relationships are an exact science
Helping relationships are an art that combines technique and humanity
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Helping relationships are an art that combines technique and humanity.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should he leave?
options: Patient relations are in full evolution, full of opportunities
Patient relations are of no interest
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Patient relations are in full evolution, and opportunities are numerous.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must create a mentoring program in helping relationships. What is the main objective?
options: Transmit fundamental skills in helping relationships
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental skills in helping relationships.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must manage the succession of his relational expertise. What is the best strategy?
options: Progressively prepare the transmission of skills
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Progressive preparation for the transmission of skills is the key to a successful succession.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must create a patient relations charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
options: Respect and kindness towards the patient
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Respect and kindness are the pillars of any quality patient relationship.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must train future mentors in helping relationships. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must prepare a testimony on her journey in helping relationships. What is the most striking element?
options: The gratitude of patients thanks to a trusting relationship
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The gratitude of patients is the most striking element of my career.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must create an alumni association for helping relationships. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the bond and promote mutual aid
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mutual aid and the bond are the driving forces of an alumni association.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must write an article on the future of helping relationships. Which trend should be emphasized?
options: The humanization of care in the digital age
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The humanization of care in the digital age is a promising trend.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must create a relational quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The quality of listening and empathy are the fundamental criteria.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
options: The profession needs enthusiasts of human relationships
The profession is of no interest
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The profession needs enthusiasts of human relationships.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must create an award for young dentists in helping relationships. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Excellence in communication is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must write her memoirs. What common thread should be highlighted?
options: The passion for human relationships and service to patients
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The passion for human relationships is the common thread of a professional life.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must create a training center for helping relationships. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Training must produce professionals of human relationships.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Skills in helping relationships and an example to follow
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Skills in helping relationships and example are the most beautiful legacy.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must write a letter to future dentists about helping relationships. What message should he convey?
options: Helping relationships are a fascinating and promising discipline
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Helping relationships are a fascinating and promising discipline.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must create a scholarship for students in helping relationships. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future of helping relationships.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must give a closing speech. What note should he leave?
options: Helping relationships continue to evolve with those who carry them
Helping relationships are of no interest
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Helping relationships continue to evolve thanks to those who carry them.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must pass on her relational knowledge. What is the priority?
options: Sell her knowledge at the highest price
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Transmitting the continuity of skills is the most beautiful achievement.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must create a peer network for young dentists in helping relationships. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual aid and experience sharing
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mutual aid and sharing are essential for young dentists.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina must write a conclusion to her work. What is the final sentence?
options: Helping relationships are a magnificent human adventure
Helping relationships are of no interest
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Helping relationships are a magnificent human adventure.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami must leave a message for future generations. What is the message?
options: Helping relationships are a discipline worth experiencing
Helping relationships are of no interest
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Helping relationships are a discipline worth experiencing.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: 🐆 Mina, after a life dedicated to helping relationships, receives a national tribute. 🦅 Sami is by her side. What is Mina's message to young dentists?
options: Helping relationships need passion and dedication
Helping relationships are of no interest
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina concludes: 'Helping relationships need passion and dedication to continue evolving.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'
